title: A morphism factors uniquely through its coimage and its image
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism of a preadditive category whose kernel, cokernel, image and coimage all exist factors uniquely through its coimage and its image (statement lines 514-520). The proof is a complete argument: the universal property of the coimage produces a canonical morphism out of it (proof lines 522-525), the composite of that morphism with the projection to the cokernel is shown to vanish using the uniqueness supplied by a named lemma (proof lines 526-530), and the resulting factorisation through the image gives the unique middle map (proof lines 530-532). The non-formal content is the verification that the composite into the cokernel vanishes. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
